frame_480_failure.visual_observation: Two eggs visible on table with demonstrator hand in physical contact spinning the egg
frame_480_failure.root_cause: Demonstrator fingers occluded the egg contour, causing solidity (0.7673) to drop below the minimum convexity threshold (0.78), causing component rejection.

solidity_relaxation_experiment.false_positive_range: Frames 244 to 298 (table reflection and demonstrator hand gesture produced a 3rd component with solidity ~0.76 at center x ~ 569, y ~ 442)
solidity_relaxation_experiment.conclusion: Global solidity relaxation to 0.75 introduces widespread false-positive blob detections. The 0.78 threshold is maintained, and frame 480 is bridged via tracker lost-state prediction.
